derivation: W=F·s=Fs cos(theta). The displacement is +x; only the parallel force component contributes. F=4 N and s=3 m give W=12 cos(theta) J. Positive for theta<90 degrees, zero at90, negative beyond90. At0,90,120,180 degrees the exact physical results are12,0,-6,-12 J. The independent transfer at90 degrees is0 J. This is work of the given force, not a general assertion about the total kinetic-energy change.

Display scales differ for force and displacement, so no physical equality can be inferred from their graphical length ratio. Gray axes remain in their plane.
